title: Swarm
summary: An educational public framework for ergonomic multi-agent orchestration.
intended_users: Developers learning explicit agent, tool, context, and handoff patterns.

design_decisions.problem_or_constraint: Make multi-agent coordination and handoffs understandable.
design_decisions.alternatives_considered: One opaque agent is simpler but hides delegation and context transfer.
design_decisions.chosen_approach_and_rationale: Represent agents, functions, context, and handoffs through a small orchestration loop.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: The repository is educational and explicitly not a production framework.
design_decisions.validation_approach: Review committed orchestration, handoff, streaming, and context tests without execution.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Use a production-supported framework when reliability and operations are required.

testing_strategy: Committed tests exercise core orchestration behaviors; Finch never executes them.
security_threat: Tools, prompts, model output, and provider calls cross trust boundaries with limited repository-level controls.
production_limitation: The project is educational; static review cannot establish model quality, provider behavior, or safe production operation.
technical_debt: Production reliability and containment are outside the stated scope.
track_alignment_explanation: AI is essential and orchestration concepts are explicit and bounded for learners.

ai_disclosure.purposes: No upstream AI-use claim; calibration narrative only.
